speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I understand you've been waking up frightened; how often does this happen, and do you recall any scary dreams or noises just before these episodes? Please tell me if you have ever seen strange figures or felt a cold breeze when you sleep.

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. To narrow this down, has she ever had a specific terrifying dream that she can describe in detail, or does she wake up with no memory of what happened? Also, do these episodes occur during the night or upon falling asleep?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Difficulty sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened. I also have Yelling and crying during sleep episodes, Temporary post-episode tiredness, Recollection of bad dreams, Bedtime procrastination. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.
